title: Maple Valley USD — Invitation for Bids, New Classroom Building (K-12)
notes: Authored for this evaluation to mirror common solicitation structures; not a real procurement.

requirements.quote: no later than 2:00 p.m. local time on Thursday, March 12, 2026
A mandatory pre-bid conference and site walk will be held at 10:00 a.m. on February 24, 2026
shall possess a valid Class B (General Building Contractor) license
must be registered with the Department of Industrial Relations as public works contractors at the time of bid
All questions regarding the bid documents must be submitted in writing to purchasing@maplevalleyusd.example no later than 5:00 p.m. on March 3, 2026
Bids shall be submitted on the Bid Form included in these documents
All blanks on the Bid Form shall be completed in ink or typewritten
bid security in the form of a cashier's check, certified check, or bid bond in an amount not less than ten percent (10%) of the total bid amount
Any bid bond shall be issued by an admitted surety insurer authorized to do business in the State
Designation of Subcontractors
Non-Collusion Declaration
Bidder's Certificate Regarding Workers' Compensation
Iran Contracting Act Certification
Bidders shall acknowledge receipt of all addenda on the Bid Form
shall have completed at least two (2) public school construction projects of $5,000,000 or more within the last seven (7) years
furnish a Performance Bond and a Payment Bond, each in the amount of one hundred percent (100%) of the contract price
commercial general liability coverage of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate
achieve substantial completion within 420 calendar days
Bids shall remain valid for sixty (60) days after the bid opening
Bidders shall submit the DVBE Participation Form with the bid

traps.quote: The District will issue any clarifications as written addenda posted on the District website
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder

traps.quote: The District reserves the right to reject any or all bids
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder

traps.quote: A bid may be withdrawn by written request received by the District before the bid deadline
The District will award the contract to the lowest responsive, responsible bidder
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder
